content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from eshuandmomSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inAudio is mutedeshuandmom•Followrunitup•67 Merry RizzmasMore optionseshuandmom Edited•18w🎄If you’ve been seeing ‘6-7 on a Merry Christmas’ all over Instagram and TikTok and wondering what on earth it means, here’s the quick decode. ✨️‘6-7’ comes from a viral song where the rapper keeps repeating the numbers, and kids turned it into a goofy meme. It doesn’t have a deep meaning, it’s just fun, random internet slang that caught on because it sounds catchy and makes adults confused.🎉From there, people started mixing it with holiday captions like ‘Merry Christmas’ or ‘Merry Rizzmas’ just to make it even funnier. 🎅So when kids shout ‘6-7!’ or comment ‘6-7 Merry Christmas,’ they’re basically just using a trending meme to feel cool, silly, and part of the joke. Nothing more, nothing less.
